parsed.rationale: Both records carry all context flags as false, so no restraint marker applies directly. However, the second member `MockNotificationMessage` lives in `Shared/Core/Sources/CoreTesting/_Plant_MockNotificationMessage.swift` — the `CoreTesting` module and the `_Plant_Mock` filename prefix are strong conventional signals that this type is a hand-authored or generated test-support mock fixture, even though `is_mock` is not set to true in the metadata. The structural match (3 shared fields, empty `fields_or_signature`) between `MainActorNotificationMessage` and `MockNotificationMessage` is almost certainly intentional: the mock mirrors the production protocol so that test infrastructure can substitute it. Merging or extracting these two would couple production observation semantics in `Core` to testing infrastructure in `CoreTesting`, which is the canonical anti-pattern the restraint rules are designed to prevent.
